chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about madhy that comes onto the garment, and he said: “He sprinkles it with water, if he wishes.”
And regarding maniyy that comes onto the garment, he said: “If you know its place, then wash it; and if it is hidden from you, then wash all of it.”

key_terms.اَلثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the fluid
key_terms.اَلْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid mentioned in the ruling concerning clothing
key_terms.اَلْمَنِيِّ: semen referred to in the ruling of washing the garment
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, meaning the whole garment when the spot is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانَهُ: its location on the garment, if known

ai.seo_question: What should be done if madhy or maniyy gets on a garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning impurity on clothing. It distinguishes between madhy, for which sprinkling water is mentioned, and maniyy, for which the affected area must be washed, or the entire garment if the place is unknown.
